name: Knees-to-Chest Stretch
steps: Lie flat on your back on the floor with your legs extended and your shoulders relaxed.
Bend both knees and draw them smoothly up toward your chest, wrapping your arms around your shins or behind your thighs.
Keep your head and shoulders down as you draw your thighs closer until you feel a gentle stretch.
Hold the stretch steadily with slow, deep breaths, then release your legs gently back down to the floor.
tips: Hold behind your thighs instead of over your kneecaps if deep knee flexion feels uncomfortable.
Keep your shoulders and neck relaxed down into the floor.
